description: Summary table of construct identities and figure of catalytic-Lys / PP1-Val positions per LMTK1 numbering frame
code:
import requests, re, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"aigr-curation-agent"})

j=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6ZMQ8.json",timeout=60).json()
print("Q6ZMQ8 secondary (merged-in) accessions:", j.get("secondaryAccessions"))
print("UniProt entry name:", j["uniProtkbId"], "| gene:", [g["geneName"]["value"] for g in j.get("genes",[])],
      "| synonyms:", [s["value"] for g in j.get("genes",[]) for s in g.get("synonyms",[])])
xr=[x for x in j.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[]) if x["database"] in ("RefSeq","EMBL","CCDS")]
print("\nRefSeq / CCDS cross-references:")
for x in xr:
    if x["database"] in ("RefSeq","CCDS"):
        print("  ",x["database"], x["id"], [p["value"] for p in x.get("properties",[])])

# check whether NM_004920 / NP_004911 is linked to a Q6ZMQ8 isoform at all
print("\nIs NP_004911 mapped to any Q6ZMQ8 isoform in UniProt? ",
      any("NP_004911" in x["id"] or any("NP_004911" in str(p) for p in x.get("properties",[])) for x in xr))

# ---- summary table ----
rows=[
 dict(construct="Woods 2022 (PMID:35902728) AATK wt / KD",
      stated_in_paper="no accession, no residue number, no size; source cited as 'Ma and Rubin [16]' but xref CR16 = Haag 2014",
      resolvable="NO", maps_to="undetermined: 4 Ma&Rubin constructs + 1 Haag construct are all possible"),
 dict(construct="Haag 2014 (PMID:25352953) Aatk  [= xref CR16 of Woods 2022]",
      stated_in_paper="'full length cDNA vector IRAVp968F06121D (Accession Number: BC080846; 5277 bp in pYX-Asc)'",
      resolvable="YES", maps_to="MOUSE Aatk, 1317 aa = NP_031403.2; not a human Q6ZMQ8 isoform"),
 dict(construct="Ma & Rubin 2014 human AATKA-FLAG",
      stated_in_paper="primer set 1 fwd GCCACCATGGCCAAGC (Suppl. Table 1)",
      resolvable="YES", maps_to="Q6ZMQ8-1 residues 104-1374 = NP_004911.2 (1271 aa); NOT a UniProt Q6ZMQ8 isoform"),
 dict(construct="Ma & Rubin 2014 human AATKB-FLAG",
      stated_in_paper="primer set 5 fwd GCCACCATGTCGTCG (Suppl. Table 1)",
      resolvable="YES", maps_to="Q6ZMQ8-1 canonical, 1374 aa"),
 dict(construct="Ma & Rubin 2014 mouse AatkA-FLAG",
      stated_in_paper="'pYX-Asc-MGC Mouse Aatk cDNA (MMM1013-202799199)'",
      resolvable="YES", maps_to="MOUSE 1317 aa = NP_031403.2 / BC080846 CDS"),
 dict(construct="Gagnon 2007 (PMID:17267545) AATYK1",
      stated_in_paper="abstract: 'a key valine residue (V1175)' in the PP1 docking motif; species not stated in abstract; full text not retrievable",
      resolvable="BY SEQUENCE ONLY", maps_to="MOUSE 1317 aa (NP_031403.2): unique sequence placing the KAVSF valine at 1175"),
]
t=pd.DataFrame(rows)
t.to_csv("construct_identity_table.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95); pd.set_option("display.width",320)
print("\n"+t.to_string(index=False))

# ---- figure: catalytic Lys and PP1 Val positions per numbering frame ----
frames=[("Q6ZMQ8-1 human, 1374 aa\n(= Ma&Rubin human AATKB)",1374,156,1232),
        ("NP_004911.2 human, 1271 aa\n(= Ma&Rubin human AATKA)",1271,53,1129),
        ("Q6ZMQ8-3 human, 879 aa",879,156,None),
        ("Q6ZMQ8-2 human, 446 aa",446,None,None),
        ("Q80YE4 mouse, 1365 aa",1365,157,1223),
        ("NP_031403.2 mouse, 1317 aa\n(= BC080846 CDS)",1317,109,1175)]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,5.4))
y=np.arange(len(frames))[::-1]
for yi,(nm,L,K,V) in zip(y,frames):
    ax.plot([1,L],[yi,yi],color="#90A4AE",lw=6,solid_capstyle="butt")
    if K: ax.plot(K,yi,"o",color="#1565C0",ms=8,zorder=3)
    if V: ax.plot(V,yi,"s",color="#2E7D32" if V==1175 else "#9E9E9E",ms=8,zorder=3)
    if V: ax.annotate(f"V{V}",(V,yi),xytext=(0,9),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,
                      color="#2E7D32" if V==1175 else "#616161")
    if K: ax.annotate(f"K{K}",(K,yi),xytext=(0,9),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#1565C0")
ax.axvline(1175,color="#C62828",ls="--",lw=1.4)
ax.text(1175,len(frames)-0.55,"V1175 (PMID:17267545)",color="#C62828",fontsize=9,ha="right")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f[0] for f in frames],fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Residue number"); ax.set_xlim(-40,1450)
ax.set_title("Catalytic lysine (circle) and PP1-docking valine of KAVSF (square) in each LMTK1 numbering frame",fontsize=10.5)
ax.spines[["top","right","left"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
